none: PAS CAM-6C1F46: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Nummus of Helena, AD337-340
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [PAX] PVBLICA ; D/ FL IVL HELENAE AVG

A copper-alloy Nummus of Helena, AD337-340 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [PAX] PVBLICA. Reverse shows Pax standing left, holding branch and transverse sceptre. Mint is Trier. See RIC vol.VIII, p.143, no.55. Obverse legend reads FL IVL HELENAE AVG. Obverse shows draped bust right. Reverse field and exergue reads: -/-//TRP. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight 1.36g, diameter 15.60mm
